newsitem.title: UK: UK harmonised CPI up 1.6% in 12 mths to May.
newsitem.headline: UK harmonised CPI up 1.6% in 12 mths to May.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said the UK's harmonised index of consumer prices rose 1.6% in the 12 months to May, unchanged from the 12-month increase in April.
The HCPI is being calculated in each member state of the EU for purposes of international comparision.
In the UK, the HCPI does not replace the retail prices index which remains the best indicator of UK consumer price inflation.
